Title: Azure HDInsight supports latest projects from Apache Hadoop

Body.Content:
Azure HDInsight 3.3 now supports Apache Hadoop 2.7.1 and Hortonworks Data Platform (HDP) 2.3. HDP 2.3 contains a number of notable improvements for enhanced enterprise readiness, including usability improvements for Hadoop. For more information, see:
  • Chapter 1. HDP 2.3.0 Release Notes What's new in the Hadoop cluster versions provided by HDInsight?
